title: Super Black Boxes Revisited
summary: Let $ κ, θ< λ$ be cardinals, with $λ$ and $κ$ regular. Concentrating on a simple case, we say that the triple $(λ,κ,θ)$ has a Super Black Box when the following holds. For some stationary $S \subseteq \{δ< λ: cf(δ) = κ\}$ and $\overline C = \langle C_δ: δ\in S \rangle$, where $C_δ$ is a club of $δ$ of order type $κ$, for every coloring $\overline F = \langle F_δ: δ\in S \rangle$ with $F_δ: {}^{C_δ}λ\to θ$, there exists $\langle c_δ: δ\in S\rangle \in {}^S\!θ$ such that for every $f : λ\to θ$, for stationarily many $δ\in S$, we have $F_δ(f \upharpoonright C_δ) = c_δ$.
